author: MrInsane
name: MassVoice
description: Mass mute or mass deafen all members in a voice channel with a persistent undo button.
install_msg: Thank you for installing MassVoice! Use `/massmute` or `/massdeafen` to manage your voice channels.
short: Mass mute or mass deafen with persistent undo button.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores the Discord user IDs of members who are mass muted or mass deafened in order to support the undo/release functionality.
